purpose: Teach: カジュアル/リベラル/オールド/エコノミー/ノーマン/ヘルパー/カセット/イレブン

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、カジュアルなお洋服がお似合いだよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You know, our customer has such good taste in casual clothes.
lines.style: Soft, wondering tone. Speaking more to herself than to Aoi. Gentle observation, like noticing something true about someone she's thinking of. Warm, unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、リベラルな政治思想のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They shared some really thoughtful ideas about politics with me the other day.
lines.style: Quiet appreciation in the voice. Leaning slightly into the memory. Not performing — genuine respect for being seen and heard. Slight smile underneath the words.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、オールドファッションのお酒がお好きだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they love a good old fashioned. I noticed that about them.
lines.style: Soft, almost private reflection. The satisfaction of knowing a small, true thing about someone. Brief pause before speaking, like she's choosing the words carefully. Gentle trailing off.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、海外出張でエコノミークラスを選ばれてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Economy class on international trips — they don't make a fuss about it.
lines.style: Admiring, understated. Not raising the tone to emphasize the point. Speaking as though describing something quietly good she'd observed. Calm, steady delivery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、映画「ノーマン」のお話を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They brought up that film, Norman — we had a whole conversation about it.
lines.style: Reflective, slightly nostalgic. The warmth of remembering a conversation that mattered. Unhurried. Slight lift at the end, like sharing something precious.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご家族の介護ヘルパーさんを称えてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They were really kind about their family's home care helper. Spoke about them with real respect.
lines.style: Quiet warmth. Speaking from genuine respect for something that showed character. No performance — just noticing what matters. Steady, grounded tone throughout.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、昔のカセットテープを集めてらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: And they collect old cassette tapes — still has them all.
lines.style: Soft, genuine interest. A small detail that somehow says something bigger about who they are. Wondering tone, not judgmental. Pace slightly slower, like cherishing the specificity.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、サッカーのイレブン、つまり代表を語って下さったよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: They talked about the national football team with such passion.
lines.style: Quiet fondness underlying the words. Reflecting back on something genuine. Warm close — not rushed, but settling into the end. Brief silence after the final word.
